units.funding_rate: native decimal rate; multiply by 10,000 for bp
units.rf: native decimal rates; multiply by 10,000 for bp
units.date: UTC calendar date from valid local_timestamp

aggregation: UTC day of valid local_timestamp; nonmissing field mean plus exact min/max and valid/missing counts. No interpolation, filling, or outlier removal.
nominal_reference: 24 is a nominal daily row-count reference only, not proof of missing observations; daily bin counts are affected by arrival-time boundaries.
rf_axis: All saved rows retained in CSV order, zero-based. source_row_index is the saved index column, not a verified market timestamp.
